study.description: Six weekly candle setups on 43 Binance coins (including ones that collapsed or were delisted), entered on daily candles at the next week's open, on a daily breakout, or on a pullback, with or without a BTC trend filter. Chosen on May 2020 to August 2024, judged on the two years after, under normal and doubled costs, risking 1% of each coin's share per trade without leverage.

entry.label: daily close above the previous day's high
pullback to mid-week, then a green day

families.idea: A week whose body engulfs the week before: bullish for longs, bearish for shorts.
families.name: Weekly engulfing

entry.label: daily close above the previous day's high
pullback to mid-week, then a green day

families.idea: A week with a long lower wick (hammer) for longs, or a long upper wick (shooting star) for shorts.
families.name: Weekly hammer or shooting star

entry.label: daily close above the previous day's high

families.idea: A three-week turn: a big week, a small one, then a strong week the other way.
families.name: Weekly morning or evening star

entry.label: daily close above the previous day's high

families.idea: Three strong weeks in a row in the same direction.
families.name: Three weekly soldiers or crows

entry.label: daily close above the previous day's high

families.idea: A week that closed at its high (or low) with almost no wicks: strong momentum.
families.name: Weekly marubozu

families.idea: Last week stayed inside the week before; buy a daily close above last week's high (sell below its low).
families.name: Inside-week breakout
